title: Geometric Algebra for Physicists
why: A full textbook connecting geometric products, rotations, spacetime and physics.
把幾何積、旋轉、時空與物理連起來的完整教材。

title: Geometric Algebra for Computer Graphics
why: A practical introduction to points, lines, planes and rigid motions in PGA.
用點、線、面與剛體運動進入射影幾何代數。

title: clifford Documentation
why: Reference examples for multivectors, signatures and geometric products.
查閱多重向量、號差與幾何積的程式範例。

title: The Algebra of Spacetime
authors: Chris Doran; Anthony Lasenby; Stephen Gull
why: The authors introduce spacetime algebra and its electromagnetic interpretation.
作者以時空代數介紹電磁學的幾何解讀。

title: The Dirac Equation
publication: University of Cambridge, Quantum Field Theory lecture notes
why: Spinors, the Lorentz group and Clifford relations in their field-theory setting.
在場論脈絡下閱讀旋量、洛侖茲群與克利福德關係。

title: Gauge Theory
why: Connections, curvature and the geometric meaning of gauge fields.
補上聯絡、曲率與規範場的幾何意義。

title: The Standard Model: Chapter 1
why: A source for discrete symmetries and the assumptions behind CPT.
查核離散對稱與 CPT 定理所依賴的假設。

title: The Spacetime Geometry of a Null Electromagnetic Field
why: A research-level treatment of null electromagnetic geometry.
零範電磁場幾何的研究論文。

title: Geometric Algebra Transformer
why: Projective geometric algebra inside a transformer architecture.
把射影幾何代數放進 Transformer 的架構。

title: Clifford Group Equivariant Neural Networks
why: Read the construction and proof of Clifford-group equivariant layers.
閱讀克利福德群等變網絡層的構造與證明。

title: Euclidean, Projective, Conformal: Choosing a Geometric Algebra for Equivariant Transformers
authors: Pim de Haan; Taco Cohen; Johann Brehmer
why: Compare different algebra choices for geometric transformers.
比較幾何 Transformer 採用不同代數的取捨。

title: On the Space-Theory of Matter
why: Read Clifford’s own geometric speculation in its original historical form.
直接閱讀克利福德的幾何推想，分清原文與後來的詮釋。

title: Applications of Grassmann’s Extensive Algebra
why: The original paper connecting Grassmann’s algebra with metric multiplication.
結合格拉斯曼代數與度規乘法的原始論文。

title: Anyhow Stories, Moral and Otherwise
why: A primary title-page source for the authorship attribution.
用原書扉頁核對露西・克利福德的作者身分。
